pob.text: How she sits alone[a], the city once full of people! She has become like a widow, she who was great among the nations, a princess among the provinces; she has become subject to forced labor.

spob.text: How she sits alone now—the city that was once full of people! She is now like a widow. Once great among the nations, a princess among the provinces, she has now been made to do forced labor.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: How lonely lies the city, once so full of people! She who was great among the nations has become a widow. The princess of the provinces has become a slave.
public_domain_references.web: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!
public_domain_references.asv: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! She is become as a widow, that was great among the nations! She that was a princess among the provinces is become tributary!
public_domain_references.kjv: How doth the city sit solitary, [that was] full of people! [how] is she become as a widow! she [that was] great among the nations, [and] princess among the provinces, [how] is she become tributary!
public_domain_references.brenton: [][]Aleph. How does the city that was filled with people sit solitary! she is become as a widow: she that was magnified among the nations, [and] princess among the provinces, has become tributary.

pob.text: She weeps bitterly in the night[a], with her tears on her cheeks; among all her lovers she has no comforter. All her companions have dealt treacherously with her[b]; they have become her enemies.

spob.text: She weeps bitterly at night, with tears on her cheeks. Among all her lovers[a], no one comforts her. All her companions[b] have betrayed her. They have become her enemies.

public_domain_references.bsb: She weeps aloud in the night, with tears upon her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
public_domain_references.web: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.
public_domain_references.asv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; Among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; they are become her enemies.
public_domain_references.kjv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears [are] on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort [her:] all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
public_domain_references.brenton: Beth. She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; and there is none of all her lovers to comfort her: all that were her friends have dealt deceitfully with her, they are become her enemies.

pob.text: Judah has gone into exile because of affliction and because of great servitude; she dwells among the nations and finds no rest[a]. All her pursuers have overtaken her in the narrow places.

spob.text: Judah has gone into exile because of suffering and harsh forced labor. She lives among the nations and can find no rest. All who pursued her caught her in narrow places where she could not escape.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest. All her pursuers have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
public_domain_references.web: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.
public_domain_references.asv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude; She dwelleth among the nations, she findeth no rest: All her persecutors overtook her within the straits.
public_domain_references.kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
public_domain_references.brenton: Gimel. Judea is gone into captivity by reason of her affliction, and by reason of the abundance of her servitude: she dwells among the nations, she has not found rest: all her pursuers have overtaken her between her oppressors.

pob.text: The roads of Zion mourn[a], because no one comes to the appointed feast; all her gates are desolate, her priests groan, her virgins grieve[b], and she herself is bitter.

spob.text: Zion’s roads mourn because no one comes for the appointed feast.[a] All her gates lie desolate. Her priests groan, her virgins[b] grieve, and Zion herself suffers bitterly.

public_domain_references.bsb: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to her appointed feasts. All her gates are deserted; her priests groan, her maidens grieve, and she herself is bitter with anguish.
public_domain_references.web: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.
public_domain_references.asv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly; All her gates are desolate, her priests do sigh: Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.
public_domain_references.kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she [is] in bitterness.
public_domain_references.brenton: Daleth. The ways of Sion mourn, because there are none that come to the feast: all her gates are ruined: her priests groan, her virgins are led captive, and she is in bitterness in herself.

pob.text: Her foes have become the head[a]; her enemies prosper, because Yahweh has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions[b]. Her children have gone away into captivity before the foe.

spob.text: Her foes are now in charge, and her enemies prosper.[a] Yahweh has brought suffering on her because of her many acts of rebellion. Her children[b] have gone away as captives before the foe.

public_domain_references.bsb: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the LORD has brought her grief because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.
public_domain_references.web: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for Yahweh has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.
public_domain_references.asv: Her adversaries are become the head, her enemies prosper; For Jehovah hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: Her young children are gone into captivity before the adversary.
public_domain_references.kjv: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
public_domain_references.brenton: He. Her oppressors are become the head, and her enemies have prospered; for the Lord has afflicted her because of the multitude of her sins: her young children are gone into captivity before the face of the oppressor.

pob.text: From daughter Zion all her splendor has departed[a]; her princes have become like deer that find no pasture[b]; they went without strength before the pursuer.

spob.text: All the splendor of daughter Zion is gone.[a] Her princes are like deer that could not find pasture. With no strength left, they went ahead of the one pursuing them.

public_domain_references.bsb: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; they lack the strength to flee in the face of the hunter.
public_domain_references.web: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.
public_domain_references.asv: And from the daughter of Zion all her majesty is departed: Her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, And they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
public_domain_references.kjv: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts [that] find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
public_domain_references.brenton: Vau. And all her beauty has been taken away from the daughter of Sion: her princes were as rams finding no pasture, and are gone [away] in weakness before the face of the pursuer.

pob.text: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and her wanderings all her precious things that were from days of old[a]. When her people fell into the hand of the foe, and there was no one to help her, foes saw her[b]; they laughed at her ruin.

spob.text: In her days of suffering and wandering[a], Jerusalem remembered all the precious things she had long ago. Her people fell into the enemy’s hands, and no one came to help her. Her enemies saw her and laughed at her ruin.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.
public_domain_references.web: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.
public_domain_references.asv: Jerusalem remembereth in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old: When her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and none did help her, The adversaries saw her, they did mock at her desolations.
public_domain_references.kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, [and] did mock at her sabbaths.
public_domain_references.brenton: Zain. Jerusalem remembered the days of her affliction, and her rejection; [she thought on] all her desirable things which were from the days of old, when her people fell into the hands of the oppressor, and there was none to help her: when her enemies saw [it] they laughed at her habitation.

pob.text: Jerusalem has sinned grievously[a]; therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness[c][b]. She herself also groans and turns backward.

spob.text: Jerusalem has sinned terribly, so she has become unclean[a] and is shunned. Everyone who once honored her now despises her because they have seen her nakedness. Jerusalem herself groans and turns away.

public_domain_references.bsb: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.
public_domain_references.web: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
public_domain_references.asv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is become as an unclean thing; All that honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: Yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
public_domain_references.kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
public_domain_references.brenton: Heth. Jerusalem has sinned a [great] sin; therefore has she come into tribulation, all that used to honour her have afflicted her, for they have seen her shame: yea, she herself groaned, and turned backward.

pob.text: Her uncleanness was in her skirts[a]; she did not remember her end. So she came down astonishingly; there was no comforter for her. Look, O Yahweh, my affliction[c][b], for the enemy has magnified himself.

spob.text: Her uncleanness clung to her skirts. She gave no thought to her end.[a] So she came down in a shocking collapse, and no one was there to comfort her. “Look, O Yahweh, at my affliction, for the enemy has exalted himself!”

public_domain_references.bsb: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
public_domain_references.web: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”
public_domain_references.asv: Her filthiness was in her skirts; she remembered not her latter end; Therefore is she come down wonderfully; she hath no comforter: Behold, O Jehovah, my affliction; for the enemy hath magnified himself.
public_domain_references.kjv: Her filthiness [is] in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified [himself].
public_domain_references.brenton: Teth. Her uncleanness is before her feet; she remembered not her last end; she has lowered her boasting [tone], there is none to comfort her. Behold, O Lord, my affliction: for the enemy has magnified himself.

pob.text: The enemy has stretched out his hand over all her precious things[c][b][a], for she has seen nations enter her sanctuary—those whom you commanded not to enter your assembly.

spob.text: The enemy reached out his hand to seize all her precious things, because she has seen foreign nations enter her sanctuary—nations you commanded not to enter your assembly.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The adversary has seized all her treasures. For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary— those You had forbidden to enter Your assembly.
public_domain_references.web: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.
public_domain_references.asv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: For she hath seen that the nations are entered into her sanctuary, Concerning whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thine assembly.
public_domain_references.kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen [that] the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command [that] they should not enter into thy congregation.
public_domain_references.brenton: Jod. The oppressor has stretched out his hand on all her desirable things: for she has seen the Gentiles entering into her sanctuary, [concerning] whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

pob.text: All her people groan[a], seeking bread; they have given their precious things for food to restore life. Look, O Yahweh, and see[c][b], for I have become despised.

spob.text: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have given their precious belongings in exchange for food to stay alive. Look, Yahweh—see how despised I have become!

public_domain_references.bsb: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have traded their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. Look, O LORD, and consider, for I have become despised.
public_domain_references.web: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, Yahweh, and see, for I have become despised.”
public_domain_references.asv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh the soul: See, O Jehovah, and behold; for I am become abject.
public_domain_references.kjv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
public_domain_references.brenton: Chaph. All her people groan, seeking bread: they have given their desirable things for meat, to restore their soul: behold, Lord, and look; for she is become dishonoured.

pob.text: Is it nothing to you[a], all you who pass by on the road? Look and see whether there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which was dealt to me[b], with which Yahweh afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

spob.text: Does my suffering mean nothing to you,[a] all you who pass by on the road? Look and see: Is there any sorrow like mine—sorrow inflicted on me by Yahweh on the day of his fierce anger?

public_domain_references.bsb: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see! Is there any sorrow like mine, which was inflicted on me, which the LORD made me suffer on the day of His fierce anger?
public_domain_references.web: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
public_domain_references.asv: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? Behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is brought upon me, Wherewith Jehovah hath afflicted [me] in the day of his fierce anger.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ [Is it] nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted [me] in the day of his fierce anger.
public_domain_references.brenton: Lamed. All ye that pass by the way, turn, and see if there is sorrow like to my sorrow, which has happened [to me]. The Lord who spoke by me has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

pob.text: From on high he sent fire into my bones[a], and it prevailed against them; he spread a net for my feet; he turned me back; he made me desolate[b], faint all day long.

spob.text: From high above, he sent fire into my bones, and the fire overpowered them.[a] He spread a net to trap my feet and forced me to turn back. He devastated me and made me weak all day long.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
public_domain_references.web: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.
public_domain_references.asv: From on high hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them; He hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: He hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
public_domain_references.kjv: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate [and] faint all the day.
public_domain_references.brenton: Mem. He has sent fire from his lofty habitation, he has brought it into my bones: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate [and] mourning all the day.

pob.text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand[a]; they are woven together, they have come up upon my neck; he has made my strength fail[c][b]. The Lord has given me into hands from which I cannot rise.

spob.text: By his hand, he has bound and woven my transgressions into a yoke,[a] and it has come up on my neck. He has made my strength fail. The Lord has handed me over into the power of others, and I cannot rise.

public_domain_references.bsb: My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
public_domain_references.web: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
public_domain_references.asv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they are come up upon my neck; he hath made my strength to fail: The Lord hath delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
public_domain_references.kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, [and] come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into [their] hands, [from whom] I am not able to rise up.
public_domain_references.brenton: Nun. He has watched over my sins, they are twined about my hands, they have come up on my neck: my strength has failed; for the Lord has laid pains on my hands, I shall not be able to stand.

pob.text: The Lord has rejected all my mighty men in my midst[a]; he has summoned an appointed time against me to crush my young men[b]. The Lord has trodden the winepress for the virgin daughter of Judah.

spob.text: The Lord has rejected all my warriors who were here with me. He has called an appointed gathering against me[a] to crush my young men. The Lord has trampled the virgin daughter of Judah like grapes in a winepress.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst; He has summoned an army against me to crush my young warriors. Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
public_domain_references.web: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.
public_domain_references.asv: The Lord hath set at nought all my mighty men in the midst of me; He hath called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men: The Lord hath trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah.
public_domain_references.kjv: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty [men] in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, [as] in a winepress.
public_domain_references.brenton: Samech. The Lord has cut off all my strong men from the midst of me: he has summoned against me a time for crushing my choice men: the Lord has trodden a wine-press for the virgin daughter of Juda: for these things I weep.

pob.text: For these things I am weeping; my eye[a], my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who restores my soul is far from me. My children have become desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.

spob.text: I weep over these things. My eye, my eye, streams with water, because the one who comforts me and restores my life[a] is far away. My children are devastated, because the enemy has proved stronger.

public_domain_references.bsb: For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.
public_domain_references.web: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”
public_domain_references.asv: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water; Because the comforter that should refresh my soul is far from me: My children are desolate, because the enemy hath prevailed.
public_domain_references.kjv: For these [things] I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
public_domain_references.brenton: Ain. Mine eye has poured out water, because he that should comfort me, that should restore my soul, has been removed far from me: my sons have been destroyed, because the enemy has prevailed.

pob.text: Zion has spread out her hands; there is no one to comfort her[a]. Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob that his enemies surround him; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.

spob.text: Zion has reached out her hands, but no one is there to comfort her. Yahweh has given a command concerning Jacob: his enemies are to surround him. Jerusalem has become something unclean among them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed against Jacob that his neighbors become his foes. Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
public_domain_references.web: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.
public_domain_references.asv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; Jehovah hath commanded concerning Jacob, that they that are round about him should be his adversaries: Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.
public_domain_references.kjv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, [and there is] none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, [that] his adversaries [should be] round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
public_domain_references.brenton: Phe. Sion has spread out her hand, [and] there is none to comfort her: the Lord has commanded [concerning] Jacob, his oppressors are round about him: Jerusalem has become among them as a removed woman.

pob.text: Yahweh is righteous[a], for I have rebelled against his word. Hear, please, all peoples[b], and see my pain: my virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.

spob.text: Yahweh is righteous, because I rebelled against what he commanded.[a] Please listen, all peoples, and see my suffering! My young unmarried women and my young men have gone into captivity.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.
public_domain_references.web: “Yahweh is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: Hear, I pray you, all ye peoples, and behold my sorrow: My virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
public_domain_references.brenton: Tsade. The Lord is righteous; for I have provoked his mouth: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my grief: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

pob.text: I called to my lovers[a]; they deceived me[b]. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they sought food for themselves to restore their lives.

spob.text: I called to my lovers[a], but they deceived me. My priests and elders died in the city as they searched for food to revive themselves.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
public_domain_references.web: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.
public_domain_references.asv: I called for my lovers, [but] they deceived me: My priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, While they sought them food to refresh their souls.
public_domain_references.kjv: I called for my lovers, [but] they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
public_domain_references.brenton: Koph. I called my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders failed in the city; for they sought meat that they might restore their souls, and found [it] not.

pob.text: Look[a], O Yahweh, for I am in distress; my inward parts are churning; my heart is overturned within me, because I have been very rebellious[b]. Outside the sword bereaves[c]; inside the house it is like death.

spob.text: Look, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My insides are churning, and my heart is turned upside down within me, because I have been very rebellious. Outside, the sword causes bereavement; inside the house, it is like death.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.
public_domain_references.web: “Look, Yahweh; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, O Jehovah; for I am in distress; my heart is troubled; My heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: Abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, O LORD; for I [am] in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home [there is] as death.
public_domain_references.brenton: Rhechs. Behold, O Lord; for I am afflicted: my belly is troubled, and my heart is turned within me; for I have been grievously rebellious: abroad the sword has bereaved me, even as death at home.

pob.text: They have heard that I groan[a]; there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they rejoice that you have done it. You have brought the day you proclaimed[c][b]; let them become like me.

spob.text: They have heard me groaning, and I have no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard about my suffering. They rejoice because you have done this. You have brought the day you announced. Let them become like me.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that You have caused it. May You bring the day You have announced, so that they may become like me.
public_domain_references.web: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.
public_domain_references.asv: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me; All mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: Thou wilt bring the day that thou hast proclaimed, and they shall be like unto me.
public_domain_references.kjv: They have heard that I sigh: [there is] none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done [it:] thou wilt bring the day [that] thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
public_domain_references.brenton: Chsen. Hear, I pray you, for I groan: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard [of] mine afflictions, and rejoice because thou hast done [it]: thou hast brought on the day, thou hast called the time: they are become like to me.

pob.text: Let all their evil come before you[a], and deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my transgressions; for my groans are many[c][b], and my heart is sick.

spob.text: Let all the evil they have done come before you. Deal with them as you dealt with me because of all my acts of rebellion. I groan again and again, and my heart is sick.

public_domain_references.bsb: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
public_domain_references.web: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
public_domain_references.asv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; And do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
public_domain_references.kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs [are] many, and my heart [is] faint.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thau. Let all their wickedness come before thy face; and strip them, as they have made a gleaning for all my sins: for my groans are many, and my heart is grieved.

pob.text: How the Lord in his anger has clouded over daughter Zion! He has cast from heaven to earth the beauty of Israel[c][b][a], and he did not remember his footstool in the day of his anger.

spob.text: How the Lord has brought a cloud over Daughter Zion in his anger! He has thrown Israel’s beauty down from heaven to earth.[a] On the day of his anger, he did not remember his footstool.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
public_domain_references.web: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
public_domain_references.asv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He hath cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, And hath not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
public_domain_references.kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, [and] cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
public_domain_references.brenton: Aleph. How has the Lord darkened in his wrath the daughter of Sion! he has cast down the glory of Israel from heaven to earth, and has not remembered his footstool.

pob.text: The Lord has swallowed up[a], without pity, all the pastures of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of daughter Judah; he has brought them down to the ground[c][b]; he has defiled the kingdom and its princes.

spob.text: The Lord has swallowed up all Jacob’s pastures[a] without pity. In his wrath, he has torn down daughter Judah’s[b] strongholds and leveled them to the ground. He has defiled the kingdom and its princes.

public_domain_references.bsb: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.
public_domain_references.web: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
public_domain_references.asv: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: He hath thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He hath brought them down to the ground; he hath profaned the kingdom and the princes thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought [them] down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: Beth. In the day of his wrath the Lord has overwhelmed [her] as in the sea, [and] not spared: he has brought down in his fury all the beautiful things of Jacob; he has brought down to the ground the strong-holds of the daughter of Juda: he has profaned her king and her princes.

pob.text: In burning anger he has cut down every horn of Israel[a]; he has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy[b], and he has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that devours all around.

spob.text: In burning anger, he has cut down every horn of Israel—every symbol of its strength. Before the enemy, he pulled back his right hand, withdrawing his power and protection. He has burned within Jacob like a flaming fire that devours everything around it.

public_domain_references.bsb: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
public_domain_references.web: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.
public_domain_references.asv: He hath cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel; He hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy: And he hath burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
public_domain_references.kjv: He hath cut off in [his] fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, [which] devoureth round about.
public_domain_references.brenton: Gimel. He has broken in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he has turned back his right hand from the face of the enemy, and has kindled a flame in Jacob as fire, and it has devoured all things round about.

pob.text: He bent his bow like an enemy; his right hand stood ready like a foe[a], and he killed all who were pleasing to the eye in the tent of daughter Zion; he poured out his wrath like fire.

spob.text: He bent his bow as an enemy would. His right hand was ready, like a foe. In daughter Zion’s tent, he killed all the people who were beautiful or precious.[a] He poured out his wrath like fire.

public_domain_references.bsb: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned. Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye; He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
public_domain_references.web: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.
public_domain_references.asv: He hath bent his bow like an enemy, he hath stood with his right hand as an adversary, And hath slain all that were pleasant to the eye: In the tent of the daughter of Zion he hath poured out his wrath like fire.
public_domain_references.kjv: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all [that were] pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
public_domain_references.brenton: Daleth. He has bent his bow as an opposing enemy: he has strengthened his right hand as an adversary, and has destroyed all the desirable things of my eyes in the tabernacle of the daughter of Sion: he has poured forth his anger as fire.

pob.text: The Lord became like an enemy; he swallowed up Israel. He swallowed up all her palaces; he destroyed his strongholds[a], and he multiplied mourning and lamentation in Daughter Judah.

spob.text: The Lord became like an enemy. He swallowed up Israel; he swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed his strongholds.[a] He brought Daughter Judah more and more mourning and sorrow.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
public_domain_references.web: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.
public_domain_references.asv: The Lord is become as an enemy, he hath swallowed up Israel; He hath swallowed up all her palaces, he hath destroyed his strongholds; And he hath multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
public_domain_references.kjv: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
public_domain_references.brenton: He. The Lord is become as an enemy: he has overwhelmed Israel as in the sea, he has overwhelmed her palaces: he has destroyed his strong-holds, and has multiplied the afflicted and humbled ones to the daughter of Juda.

pob.text: He has laid waste his shelter like a garden[a]; he has destroyed his appointed meeting place. Yahweh has caused appointed feast and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion[c][b], and in the indignation of his anger he has spurned king and priest.

spob.text: He has ravaged his shelter like a garden.[a] He has destroyed his appointed meeting place.[b] Yahweh has made Zion forget its appointed feasts and Sabbaths.[c] In his fierce anger, he has rejected king and priest with contempt.

public_domain_references.bsb: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
public_domain_references.web: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion. In the indignation of his anger, he has despised the king and the priest.
public_domain_references.asv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden; he hath destroyed his place of assembly: Jehovah hath caused solemn assembly and sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, And hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as [if it were of] a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
public_domain_references.brenton: Vau. And he has scattered his tabernacle as a vine, he has marred his feast: the Lord has forgotten the feast and the sabbath which he appointed in Sion, and in the fury of his wrath has vexed the king, and priest, and prince.

pob.text: The Lord has rejected his altar[a]; he has abandoned his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy[c][b]. They raised a shout in the house of Yahweh as on the day of an appointed feast.

spob.text: The Lord has rejected his altar and spurned his sanctuary. He has handed the walls of Jerusalem’s palaces over to the enemy. The enemy shouted in Yahweh’s temple as on an appointed festival day.

public_domain_references.bsb: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.
public_domain_references.web: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in Yahweh’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.
public_domain_references.asv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary; He hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: They have made a noise in the house of Jehovah, as in the day of a solemn assembly.
public_domain_references.kjv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
public_domain_references.brenton: Zain. The Lord has rejected his altar, he has cast off his sanctuary, he has broken by the hand of the enemy the wall of her palaces; they have uttered their voice in the house of the Lord as on a feast day.

pob.text: Yahweh determined to destroy the wall of daughter Zion[a]; he stretched out a measuring line; he did not hold back his hand from swallowing up, and he made rampart and wall mourn[b]; together they languish.

spob.text: Yahweh decided to destroy daughter Zion’s wall.[a] He stretched out a measuring line to mark it for destruction. He did not hold back his hand from swallowing it up. He made the outer defenses and the wall mourn; together they waste away.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; He hath stretched out the line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying; And he hath made the rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
public_domain_references.brenton: Heth. And he has turned to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he has stretched out the measuring line, he has not turned back his hand from afflicting [her]: therefore the bulwark mourned, and the wall was weakened with it.

pob.text: Her gates have sunk into the earth; he has destroyed and broken her bars[a]. Her king and her princes are among the nations; there is no law. Even her prophets have found no vision from Yahweh.

spob.text: Her city gates have sunk into the earth. He has destroyed and smashed the bars that held them shut. Her king and princes are among the nations. There is no law.[a] Even her prophets have received no vision from Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yea, her prophets find no vision from Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes [are] among the Gentiles: the law [is] no [more;] her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: Teth. Her gates are sunk into the ground: he has destroyed and broken to pieces her bars, [and] her king and her prince among the Gentiles: there is no law, nay, her prophets have seen no vision from the Lord.

pob.text: The elders of daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence[a]; they have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth[b]; the virgins of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

spob.text: The elders of daughter Zion[a] sit silently on the ground. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth[b] as signs of grief. Jerusalem’s virgins[c] have bowed their heads to the ground.

public_domain_references.bsb: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
public_domain_references.web: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
public_domain_references.asv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, they keep silence; They have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
public_domain_references.kjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, [and] keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
public_domain_references.brenton: Jod. The elders of the daughter of Sion have sat upon the ground, they have kept silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloths: they have brought down to the ground the chief virgins in Jerusalem.

pob.text: My eyes are spent with tears[a]; my inward parts churn; my liver is poured out to the earth because of the destruction of the daughter of my people[d][c][b], because infant and nursing child faint in the streets of the city.

spob.text: My eyes are worn out from crying. My insides churn. My liver is poured out on the ground.[a] This is because my people—pictured as a daughter—have been devastated,[b] and because infants and nursing children faint in the city streets.

public_domain_references.bsb: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
public_domain_references.web: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
public_domain_references.asv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled; My liver is poured upon the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the young children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
public_domain_references.kjv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
public_domain_references.brenton: Chaph. Mine eyes have failed with tears, my heart is troubled, my glory is cast down to the ground, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; while the infant and suckling swoon in the streets of the city.

pob.text: They say to their mothers[a], “Where are grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city[c][b], as their life is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

spob.text: They say to their mothers, “Where can we find grain and wine?” They faint in the city streets like wounded people,[a] while their lives are poured out in their mothers’ arms.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.
public_domain_references.web: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
public_domain_references.asv: They say to their mothers, Where is grain and wine? When they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, When their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
public_domain_references.kjv: They say to their mothers, Where [is] corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
public_domain_references.brenton: Lamed. They said to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? while they fainted like wounded men in the streets of the city, while their souls were poured out into their mother's bosom.

pob.text: What can I testify for you? What can I compare you to[a], daughter Jerusalem? What can I liken to you, so that I may comfort you, virgin daughter Zion? For your fracture is as great as the sea[b]; who can heal you?

spob.text: What can I testify about you?[a] What can I compare you to, daughter Jerusalem? What can I liken you to so that I can comfort you, virgin daughter Zion?[c] Your fracture is as vast as the sea.[b] Who can heal you?

public_domain_references.bsb: What can I say for you? To what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?
public_domain_references.web: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?
public_domain_references.asv: What shall I testify unto thee? what shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? For thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
public_domain_references.kjv: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach [is] great like the sea: who can heal thee?
public_domain_references.brenton: Mem. What shall I testify to thee, or what shall I compare to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? who shall save and comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Sion? for the cup of thy destruction is enlarged: who shall heal thee?

pob.text: Your prophets saw for you falsehood and folly[a], and they did not uncover your iniquity to restore your fortunes; instead[b], they saw for you false oracles and delusions.

spob.text: The visions your prophets saw for you were false and foolish. They did not expose your sin so that your fortunes could be restored.[a] Instead, they gave you false prophetic messages[b] and visions that led you astray.

public_domain_references.bsb: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.
public_domain_references.web: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.
public_domain_references.asv: Thy prophets have seen for thee false and foolish visions; And they have not uncovered thine iniquity, to bring back thy captivity, But have seen for thee false oracles and causes of banishment.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
public_domain_references.brenton: Nun. Thy prophets have seen for thee vanities and folly: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn back thy captivity; but they have seen for thee vain burdens, and worthless visions.

pob.text: All who pass along the road clap their hands at you[a]; they hiss and shake their heads over daughter Jerusalem: “Is this the city that they called the perfection of beauty[c][b], the joy of all the earth?”

spob.text: Everyone who passes by on the road claps their hands at you. They hiss[b] and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem.[a] They ask, “Is this the city people called perfect in beauty, the joy of the whole earth?”

public_domain_references.bsb: All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
public_domain_references.web: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”
public_domain_references.asv: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, [saying], Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
public_domain_references.kjv: All that pass by clap [their] hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, [saying, Is] this the city that [men] call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
public_domain_references.brenton: Samech. All that go by the way have clapped their hands at thee; they have hissed and shaken their head at the daughter of Jerusalem. Is this the city, they say, the crown of joy of all the earth?

pob.text: All your enemies open their mouths against you[a]; they hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed you up! Surely this is the day we hoped for; we have found it[b], we have seen it.”

spob.text: All your enemies open their mouths wide to jeer at you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed you up! Surely this is the day we hoped for—we have found it and seen it!”

public_domain_references.bsb: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”
public_domain_references.web: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”
public_domain_references.asv: All thine enemies have opened their mouth wide against thee; They hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
public_domain_references.kjv: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed [her] up: certainly this [is] the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen [it].
public_domain_references.brenton: Ain. All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they have hissed and gnashed their teeth, and said, We have swallowed her up: moreover this is the day which we looked for; we have found it, we have seen it.

pob.text: Yahweh has done what he planned[a]; he has fulfilled his word, which he commanded from days of old. He has torn down and has not shown pity; he has made the enemy rejoice over you[c][b]; he has exalted the horn of your foes.

spob.text: Yahweh has done what he planned. He has fulfilled his word—the command he gave long ago. He has torn the city down without pity. He has made your enemy rejoice over you. He has lifted up the horn of your foes—their strength and honor.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah hath done that which he purposed; he hath fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old; He hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: And he hath caused the enemy to rejoice over thee; he hath exalted the horn of thine adversaries.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD hath done [that] which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused [thine] enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
public_domain_references.brenton: Phe. The Lord has done that which he purposed; he has accomplished his word, [even] the things which he commanded from the ancient days: he has thrown down, and has not spared: and he has caused the enemy to rejoice over thee, he has exalted the horn of him that afflicted thee.

pob.text: Their heart cried out to the Lord[a], O wall of daughter Zion: let tears run down like a stream day and night; give yourself no relief[c][b]; let not the apple of your eye rest.

spob.text: Their hearts[a] cried out together to the Lord. Wall of Daughter Zion, let your tears flow like a stream[b] day and night. Give yourself no relief; do not let your eyes rest from weeping.

public_domain_references.bsb: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.
public_domain_references.web: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.
